g.text: Ramp described reducing eight skills to four, shrinking an Excel skill and trajectory-distilled memory.No effect size, repeated-run result or reproducible construction was captured; these are not defaults.
Repeat stochastic assessments; inspect paired failures and uncertainty. Keep regression cases separate from final assessment.
Sources: Ramp, failure-study and Arize notes. Matrix is a proposed comparison design, with no fabricated results.
